scope: Read-only child-owned native/API/BV-BRC shared-grader public-name census. Includes parent-confirmed direct public.blast.search/public.blast.collect additions on shared DB row.
counting_rules: Count explicit scientific tool names, including named result/calculation operations.
Count each name once per top-level scientific analysis, regardless of resource or format.
Do not count generic execution.results.collect, provider strings, parser modules, PSSM/iteration component sheets, status/preparation helpers or source-only catalog entries.
Separate duplicate Rfam implementations from useful analysis count.
Configured route implementation is not live availability or whole-operation closure.

limitations: No scientific imports, tests, native binaries, HTTP services, episode replay, deployment checks or live-resource checks were run.
Whole-operation completion remains open; this census verifies source-level links only.
GeneTree/CodonTree retain distinct provider sheets although their common numerical components share an authority.
rna.cmsearch is independently published legacy output and not linked to the shared Infernal grader.
RNA comparison has a generic typed runtime path but no dedicated scientific alias.
Rfam JSON/report duplicate authorities still require R1 consolidation.
